data.value: (Preview) Watch compatible C# AppHosts and reconstruct their model after changes, enable language-native watching for compatible polyglot AppHosts, and hot reload compatible C# services added with AddDotnetProject. Defaults to the defaultWatchEnabled feature; use --watch false to turn all CLI-controlled watch paths off. Real IDE-owned runs retain IDE watch policy.
